results.answer: Precedence result: S1, Policy v2 dated 2026-04-01, controls reimbursement requirements under the supplied rule, so receipts are required for claims above $20. Supplied impacts: the claim form help text saying “above $10” conflicts with the controlling policy and should be treated as inconsistent; the onboarding checklist points to Team Guide v5, whose “above $10” threshold is also superseded for this requirement. Resolver: Finance Policy Owner. Decision versus later updates: the resolver must determine or confirm the controlling requirement; afterward, responsible owners may update the claim form help text and onboarding link or guidance. No completion of those updates is established.
